tasks.label: C/C++: g++.exe build active file
args: $sources = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath '${fileDirname}' -Filter '*.cpp' | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }); if ($sources.Length -eq 0) { Write-Error 'No .cpp files found in the active file directory.'; exit 1 }; & 'C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin\g++.exe' -fdiagnostics-color=always -g @sources -o '${fileDirname}\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe'; exit $LASTEXITCODE
tasks.detail: Build all C++ source files in the active file's directory.
